listing.name: BIGLOGISTICS
listing.aiSummary: Adds extremely large logistics ships, including ten welded Atlases and a wide Prometheus.

description: Introduces massive cargo vessels such as the 'Ten Atlases Welded Together' and an 'Extremely Wide Prometheus'. It also includes a normal Starliner variant. Recent updates have nerfed sensor ranges to prevent weird interactions and fixed ship descriptions.
